title: Spine-Friendly PPL (Dumbell/Bands/Bench)
author: Lauren Semple
desc:
Unlock your strength with the Spine-Friendly PPL program, a 12-week journey designed to enhance your upper body while prioritizing spinal health. This program features a balanced blend of push, pull, and leg workouts using dumbells. 
By strategically prioritizing upper chest density, lateral shoulder width, and upper lat thickness, we build a stark visual "V-taper" that effectively square out the upper body. 
Crucially, all lower body movements havebeen completely re-architected to avoid axial loading (overhead compression) and minimize lumbar shear forces, keeping your discs fully supported and pain-free.

ex.note: Set bench to a 30–45 degree angle. Keep shoulder blades packed tightly back into the bench.
Bench completely upright. Forcefully press your lower back into the back pad to eliminate arching.
Lie flat on your mat with knees bent, feet flat on the floor. Lower until triceps lightly touch the floor, then explode up.
Sit with back support. Hold one heavy dumbbell vertically over head with both hands; lower behind head, keeping elbows tucked.
Set bench to 30-degree incline. Lie face down with chest firmly on the pad. Row dumbbells toward your hips.
Anchor heavy band high on a door frame. Kneel on your mat, grip bands, and drive your elbows straight down to your back pockets.
Lie face down on the 30-degree incline bench. Fly dumbbells out laterally with slightly bent arms, squeezing back of shoulders.
Seated or standing with neutral posture. Palms face each other throughout the entire movement.
Anchor band at eye level. Pull toward your forehead, separating your hands at the end range. Squeeze your upper back.
Place one foot back on the bench. Hold dumbbells straight down at your sides. Keep your torso perfectly vertical as you descend.
Stand in front of the bench. Hold dumbbells at your sides. Sit backward onto the bench, pause 1 second without relaxing, drive up.
Lie completely flat on your stomach on the mat. Clamp a dumbbell securely between your feet and curl it upward to 90 degrees

ss.note: Sit on the bench. Place your dumbbells flat on top of your lower thighs just above your knees. Perform controlled calf extensions.

ex.note: Lie on your back, brace your core, and press your lower back 100% flat into the mat. Move opposite arm/leg against the band.
